n: Mission San Carlos Borromeo de Carmelo
w: First built 1771 at the mouth of the Carmel River, headquarters of all Alta California missions from 1770 to 1833, led by Junipero Serra until his 1784 death. Its chapel nearly collapsed before an 1884 roof rebuild; Harry Downie restored it over fifty years from 1931. Only mission with its original bell and tower.
s: Junipero Serra's mission HQ, restored over fifty years
